title: ast.function_body response
description: One extracted function body. All line coordinates are 1-based. (Note: the symbols / outline / parse_file responses are 0-based — this is the documented exception.) When the function isn't found, `found` is false and the line/text fields are zero/empty. When a matching declaration exists but the body cannot be isolated, `found` remains false and the declaration/fallback fields tell callers how to retarget to a line-range edit.

start_col.description: 0-based UTF-8 byte column where the body starts, or 0 when no body was isolated.

end_col.description: 0-based UTF-8 byte column where the body ends, or 0 when no body was isolated.

brace_based.description: True for every language except Python so callers can branch on indentation-based vs. brace-based body shapes.

return_object_fields.description: Field names extracted from `return { ... }` literals in the body, used by APIContractExtractor to infer response shapes.

declaration_found.description: True when a matching declaration was found, even if its body could not be isolated.

declaration_start_line.description: 1-based inclusive declaration start line, or 0 when no declaration was found.

declaration_end_line.description: 1-based inclusive declaration end line, or 0 when no declaration was found.

declaration_node_kind.description: Tree-sitter node kind for the matching declaration.

isolation_reason.description: Typed reason for the isolation status.

fallback_action.description: Actionable fallback for callers when body isolation fails.

retarget_instruction.description: Human-facing one-step retarget instruction for edit tools.
